name: Citrullus_Bacterial_Fruit_Blotch
symptoms: seedlings: Water-soaked lesions on cotyledons Necrotic lesions near veins Lesions on hypocotyl Seedling collapse and death leaves: Irregular dark-brown to black lesions (watermelon) Reddish-brown lesions (melon) Lesions spreading along veins Leaf blight symptoms fruits: Small irregular water-soaked lesions Sunken rind spots Lesions turn brown and crack Internal fruit decay Fruit rot before harvest
management: seed_management: Use pathogen-free certified seeds Seed health testing (PCR or grow-out assays) seed_treatments: Dry heat treatment (85°C for 3–5 days) Peroxyacetic acid treatment Chlorine treatments cultural_practices: Reduce humidity in greenhouses Avoid overhead irrigation Remove infected plants chemical_control: Copper-based bactericides host_resistance: No commercially reliable resistant cultivars available
sources: Journal of Plant Pathology studies on Acidovorax citrulli
